propositions: Existing guidance in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md contradicts the new directive by offering recheck as a remedy for tests that merely look transient/flaky, licensing retry-until-green rather than root-cause debugging

The rule must distinguish between environmental faults (provably recheckable with stated reasoning) and nondeterministic tests (which are bugs to be debugged via /rebar-debug workflow and fixed class-wide, not instance-wise)
Flaky CI pipelines slow development, waste tokens, and erode CI as a regression oracle; root-causing once is cheaper than repeated recheckless across multiple changes
AGENTS.md must carry the rule as concise agent guidance with rationale compressed to one sentence, naming the /rebar-debug workflow and the environmental-only carve-out
CONTRIBUTING.md section 6 must split transient failures into two cases with opposite remedies and cross-link the AGENTS.md rule instead of contradicting it
New test test_flaky_test_guidance.py must pin the rule's presence and the absence of the old retry-until-green licence to prevent regression
